// CASE ts_inorder_canonical expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: Iterable<T>,
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	{ reason }: { reason: string },
): Promise<void> {
	void reason;
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE ts_inorder_spread expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: Iterable<T>,
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	{ reason }: { reason: string },
): Promise<void> {
	void reason;
	for (const item of items) {
		log(...(await step(item)));
	}
}
